summary:
Echoes of the Cosmos is an interactive space museum created to tell the stories of NASA equipment left behind on the Moon, Mars, and in deep space. The project features virtual rooms with 3D models, real photographs, digital books, and immersive videos explaining each object’s mission, function, discoveries, and eventual fate.
Our proposal addresses the challenge by transforming complex historical and scientific information into a visual, narrative, and accessible experience for smartphones, computers, and virtual reality headsets. Visitors can explore the museum, interact with 3D models, complete daily missions, take assessments, and collect informative cards in a Cosmic Album.
This project is important because it brings space science closer to children and young people through an experience that combines education, technology, and entertainment. In this way, the machines that made major discoveries possible will not be forgotten; instead, their stories can inspire the next generation of explorers.
details:
Echoes of the Cosmos

Echoes of the Cosmos is an interactive web-based space museum that brings the stories of NASA’s historical spacecraft and scientific equipment to life. Users can walk through virtual rooms dedicated to the Moon, Mars, and deep space, where they can discover 3D models of rovers, landers, probes, and spacecraft.
Each exhibit includes an interactive menu with mixed-reality experiences, 3D model exploration, mission information, immersive videos, and galleries of real images. Visitors can rotate and zoom in on the models, learn about their objectives and discoveries, watch visual reconstructions of their missions, and explore authentic photographs.
The project is designed to work on smartphones, tablets, computers, and compatible virtual reality headsets. Its development combines HTML, CSS, JavaScript, WebGL, GLB 3D models, real NASA imagery, and educational multimedia content.

Benefits and Expected Impact

The main benefit of the project is transforming complex scientific information into an accessible, educational, and engaging experience for children, teenagers, students, and space enthusiasts. Echoes of the Cosmos promotes science education, encourages curiosity, and helps users understand the importance of the machines that made major discoveries possible.
The expected impact is to bring space exploration closer to the public in an interactive and inspiring way. The project aims to motivate more people to become interested in astronomy, science, technology, and engineering by presenting NASA’s open data and images in an easy-to-understand format.

Supporting and Production Tools

During the development process, we used ChatGPT and Codex as artificial intelligence tools to generate ideas, organize information, and support the programming process. We also used ElevenLabs to create narrations and voices, Flow Labs to develop visual resources, and CapCut Pro to edit videos, add effects, synchronize audio, and produce the final multimedia content.

Project Creativity

The creativity of Echoes of the Cosmos comes from combining a virtual museum with scientific storytelling, 3D exploration, mixed reality, immersive videos, daily missions, interactive assessments, and a Cosmic Album. In this way, users do not simply observe information; they actively participate in the learning experience and explore the content at their own pace.

Factors Considered by the Team

During development, the team considered accessibility, scientific accuracy, historical context, visual clarity, compatibility with different devices, and platform performance. We also considered the importance of presenting NASA’s open data in a clear, engaging, and inspiring way for users of different ages and levels of knowledge.
